languageSelector.label: Language
languageSelector.hint: Auto-detect is the recommended default and safe for any recording. You can select up to {{max}} languages to tell Voxis what to expect — the final transcript always follows what is actually heard in the audio.

expectedSpeakers.label: Number of speakers
expectedSpeakers.hint: Only set this if you know how many people speak in the recording. It helps speaker separation most for recordings with one or two speakers.

retranscribe.deleteFailed: Failed to delete existing transcription. No changes were made.
retranscribe.newFailed: Old transcription was removed but new one failed to start. Please transcribe again from the media library.
retranscribe.title: Retranscribe Audio
retranscribe.descriptionPrefix: This will delete the existing transcription for
retranscribe.descriptionSuffix: and start a new one with the settings below.

speakers.title: Speakers
speakers.saveFailed: Couldn't save speaker name. Try again.

transcribe.title: Transcribe Audio
transcribe.description: Configure transcription settings for this audio file.
transcribe.enhanceHint: Applies AI noise reduction before transcription. Use when speech is hard to hear — heavy wind, traffic, machinery. Adds processing time, so skip for clear recordings where transcription already works well.
